structured_output.summary: The finding was real. In src/ui/stages/screen-change.stage.ts, the stripes stage now passes `bestLaps: memoryBestLaps()` (an empty in-memory store) to createStartScreen, so it no longer falls back to the real localStorage. Every card now reads "BEST –:––.––" whatever is in browser storage. That matches what the screenshot already showed, so the rendered output and the baselines stay the same. Before the fix, the new test failed: Bramble Bends read "BEST 0:40.37" once racer.bestLap.bends was set. After the fix it passes. pnpm typecheck is clean, and pnpm test passes: 111 files, 735 tests.
